edit_prose: Indeed, wisdom and knowledge, though intertwined, can exist independently. Wisdom often stems from experience and understanding, transcending mere facts or information. One can be knowledgeable yet lack wisdom, acting without insight or judgment. Conversely, wisdom may arise from intuition or life lessons, independent of formal education or data. Thus, while knowledge informs wisdom, wisdom can guide even in the absence of specific knowledge.
